entries.title: HyperTrace: Hypothesis-Based Preference Tracing for Online LLM Personalization
entries.description: Maintains competing natural-language preference hypotheses, updates them from comparative feedback with sequential Monte Carlo, and consolidates topic-conditioned evidence into cross-session user memory.

details.abstractZh: HyperTrace 把在线用户画像建模为一组并行的自然语言偏好假设：系统从显式比较选择中用 LLM surrogate 计算证据并执行类似 sequential Monte Carlo 的重加权，在反馈信息不足时跳过更新，在主题切换时检索相关假设并把跨会话证据巩固进持久 memory。实验从 PRISM 与 PersonaMem-v2 各取 50 个合格用户（分别 1,206 与 1,335 轮），固定 GPT-5 backbone，评测偏好预测、回复对齐和画像对齐；PRISM 的 Acc>20 为 0.6136，对比 Dynamic Cheatsheet 的 0.5436，PersonaMem-v2 为 0.3768 对比 0.3035。Hybrid 配置以每轮 0.0131 美元保留 95.8% 的准确率并降低 53.1% 成本，但它仍是基于公开数据集和显式比较反馈的通用个性化研究，而非线上推荐排序系统，PersonaMem-v2 的回复对齐也未稳定改善。
details.abstractEn: HyperTrace represents an online user profile as competing natural-language preference hypotheses. It scores comparative feedback with an LLM surrogate, performs sequential-Monte-Carlo-style reweighting, skips uninformative turns, retrieves hypotheses by topic, and consolidates evidence into persistent cross-session memory. Experiments use 50 eligible users each from PRISM and PersonaMem-v2 (1,206 and 1,335 turns) with a fixed GPT-5 backbone: Acc>20 reaches 0.6136 versus 0.5436 for Dynamic Cheatsheet on PRISM and 0.3768 versus 0.3035 on PersonaMem-v2. A hybrid configuration retains 95.8% of accuracy at $0.0131 per turn, 53.1% cheaper, but this remains offline general personalization from explicit comparisons rather than an online ranking deployment, and response alignment does not improve consistently on PersonaMem-v2.

entries.title: An Efficient and Effective Agentic Group Shilling Attack on Recommender Systems
entries.description: AGAS coordinates stateful role-switching attack workers with persistent memory and victim-model feedback, using ReAct execution and Reflexion-style strategy updates to stress-test recommender robustness.

details.abstractZh: AGAS 将群体 shilling attack 组织成多 Agent 闭环：Coordinator 在 Profiler、Camouflageur、Sniper 与 Inactive 角色间动态分配 stateful worker，worker 用 ReAct 与受害模型交互，Coordinator 则通过 Reflexion 和持久 memory 根据每轮反馈调整整体策略。离线实验覆盖 ML-100K、ML-1M、Genome 2021、Netflix、Douban 与 Amazon，使用 11 个协同过滤受害模型和匹配预算；Claude Opus 4.5 配置的五次运行均值（×10^-3）为 HR@10 41.5±0.5、NDCG@10 17.6±0.3、Rec@50 95.0±1.1，对比 AgentAttack 的 35.2±1.6、14.9±1.4、84.3±1.9。该工作是防御评估所需的攻击面研究，而非良性推荐方法；证据来自模拟黑盒离线环境，没有生产攻击或防御部署，因此不应把效果外推到真实平台。
details.abstractEn: AGAS frames group shilling as a multi-agent loop. A coordinator dynamically assigns stateful workers to Profiler, Camouflageur, Sniper, and Inactive roles; workers interact with victim models through ReAct, while the coordinator uses Reflexion and persistent memory to revise the round-level strategy from feedback. Offline experiments span ML-100K, ML-1M, Genome 2021, Netflix, Douban, and Amazon with 11 collaborative-filtering victims and matched budgets; over five runs, the Claude Opus 4.5 setup reports HR@10 41.5±0.5, NDCG@10 17.6±0.3, and Rec@50 95.0±1.1 (all ×10^-3), versus AgentAttack's 35.2±1.6, 14.9±1.4, and 84.3±1.9. This is adversarial stress-testing rather than a benign recommender, and its simulated offline black-box evidence should not be extrapolated to production attacks or defenses.

entries.title: AtomRec: Evolving Atomic Memory for Agentic Recommendation
entries.description: Stores preference evidence as evolving atomic notes, links semantically related user memories, and retrieves multi-hop evidence paths for a recommendation agent instead of repeatedly rewriting monolithic profiles.

details.abstractZh: AtomRec 把推荐 Agent 的长期记忆拆成可独立更新的 atomic notes：新交互触发字段级演化而非整段画像重写，语义链接把跨用户的相关 note 组成协同 memory graph，Memory Agent 再检索多跳 evidence paths 供 Recommendation Agent 决策。使用 GPT-4o-mini 的实验覆盖 Amazon Books、Goodreads、MovieTV 与 Yelp 四个 MemRec/InstructRec 基准，并按完整 10 候选列表评测 H@3/N@3/H@5/N@5；16 个主表单元均最优，作者报告相对最强基线平均提升约 8.5%，Books 的四项指标为 0.7462/0.6690/0.8543/0.7130，对比 MemRec 的 0.6786/0.6078/0.7764/0.6480，均 p<0.05。成本匹配后仍平均提升约 6.5%，但证据只来自公开离线基准，记忆合并也可能让主导主题覆盖短期、特异偏好，尚无生产延迟和回滚验证。
details.abstractEn: AtomRec decomposes long-term recommender memory into independently editable atomic notes. New interactions trigger field-level evolution rather than monolithic profile rewriting, semantic links connect related notes across users into collaborative memory, and a Memory Agent retrieves multi-hop evidence paths for a Recommendation Agent. With GPT-4o-mini, experiments cover the Amazon Books, Goodreads, MovieTV, and Yelp MemRec/InstructRec benchmarks and evaluate H@3/N@3/H@5/N@5 over the full ten-item candidate set; AtomRec leads all 16 main-table cells, with an average relative gain of about 8.5% over the strongest baseline. On Books it reaches 0.7462/0.6690/0.8543/0.7130 versus MemRec's 0.6786/0.6078/0.7764/0.6480, all p<0.05; cost-matched gains remain about 6.5%, but evidence is offline, memory merging can suppress short-term idiosyncratic preferences, and production latency and rollback are untested.

entries.title: Agents as Knowledge Integrator and Utilizer in Multimodal Recommendation
entries.description: AgentMMRec coordinates an Integrator Agent that writes multimodal user/item knowledge memory with a Utilizer Agent that turns it into behavior-aware graphs for backbone-agnostic candidate reranking.

details.abstractZh: AgentMMRec 用 Integrator Agent 联合解释训练交互与多模态 item 内容，把用户偏好和物品属性写入可复用 knowledge memory；Utilizer Agent 再从 memory 构造 user-user/item-item 行为图、细化各模态图，并重排 backbone 的 top-50 候选。实验在 Amazon Baby、Sports、Clothing 三个 5-core 数据集上按五次运行评测 Recall@10/20 与 NDCG@10/20，测试阶段冻结 memory 和模型以避免泄漏；三域 R@20 分别为 0.1079、0.1231、0.1071，主表 12 个指标提升均报告 p<0.05。该方法的代价主要前置到离线知识构建，三个数据集分别需要 86,535、180,222 和 210,293 次 LLM 调用，因此上线收益依赖 memory 的复用周期。
details.abstractEn: AgentMMRec uses an Integrator Agent to jointly interpret training interactions and multimodal item content, writing user preferences and item properties into reusable knowledge memory; a Utilizer Agent then converts that memory into behavior-aware user-user and item-item graphs, refines modality graphs, and reranks a backbone's top-50 candidates. Five-run experiments on the 5-core Amazon Baby, Sports, and Clothing datasets evaluate Recall@10/20 and NDCG@10/20 with memory and model parameters frozen at test time; R@20 is 0.1079, 0.1231, and 0.1071, and all 12 main-table gains are reported significant at p<0.05. The cost is shifted into offline knowledge construction—86,535, 180,222, and 210,293 LLM calls across the three datasets—so deployment economics depend on how long the memory can be reused.

entries.title: When Memory Takes Gradients: Collaborative Vector Memory for Agentic Recommender Systems
entries.description: CoVeMem stores frozen LightGCN user/item states as persistent collaborative memory, retrieves candidate-conditioned history into LLM soft tokens, and trains a parametric reader with semantic alignment and masked listwise ranking.

details.abstractZh: CoVeMem 将推荐 Agent 的协同记忆从反复改写的文本叙事改造成可训练的向量状态库：冻结的 LightGCN 用户/物品状态保存全量协同结构，候选集合在每次决策时检索最相关的历史状态，并以 soft token 注入 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。语义锚点对齐、候选遮蔽与 listwise co-training 迫使 LoRA+projector 记忆读取器真正使用协同信号，而不是只看标题。实验覆盖 InstructRec 的 Books、Goodreads、MovieTV、Yelp 四个域，按 H@1/3/5 与 NDCG@3/5 评测；CoVeMem 在 20 个指标单元中的 19 个不低于最强文本记忆 Agent MemRec，且除一次静态画像外不再需要逐交互 LLM 记忆维护调用。
details.abstractEn: CoVeMem replaces repeatedly rewritten textual agent memory with a trainable collaborative vector bank: frozen LightGCN user/item states retain catalog-wide structure, while each candidate set retrieves the most relevant history and injects it as soft tokens into Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Semantic-anchor alignment, candidate masking, and listwise co-training force the LoRA-plus-projector reader to use collaborative evidence rather than titles alone. On the four InstructRec domains (Books, Goodreads, MovieTV, and Yelp), evaluated with H@1/3/5 and NDCG@3/5, CoVeMem matches or exceeds the strongest text-memory agent MemRec on 19 of 20 metric cells while requiring no per-interaction LLM calls for memory maintenance beyond one static profile.

entries.title: Conversational Recommendation over Live E-Commerce Catalogues with Self-Refreshing Retrieval
entries.description: A controller routes multi-turn shopping dialogue to preference elicitation or a search→rerank→diversity tool path, while a hash-based self-refreshing retriever keeps shared catalogue, profile, and session state current.

details.abstractZh: 该 RecSys 2026 系统面向持续上新、改价、补货和下架的真实电商目录，把多轮购物对话与 self-refreshing retrieval 组合成 merchant-agnostic Agent。Controller 将消息分成八类意图，在偏好模糊时调用 elicitor sub-agent 追问 1–3 个问题，否则调度 semantic search→可选非生成式 rerank→diversity selection；向量库、用户 profile 与 session state 由检索和对话两条流水线共享。每次同步用稳定 ID、全量 hash 与 semantic hash 区分新增、语义变化、纯 metadata 变化、删除与未变化条目，只处理 delta；500 条匿名目录上，无变化/改价库存/删除分别仅耗完整重建时间的 1.8%/2.5%/2.1%，新增或描述类别变化为 11.0%/12.3%。论文提供 WhatsApp live demo，但明确说明评测覆盖同步正确性与成本，而非推荐质量，离线相关性和用户研究仍待完成。
details.abstractEn: This RecSys 2026 system targets live e-commerce catalogues with continual additions, repricing, restocking, and deletion, combining multi-turn shopping dialogue with merchant-agnostic self-refreshing retrieval. A controller classifies messages into eight intents, invokes an elicitor sub-agent for one to three clarification questions when preferences are vague, or dispatches a semantic-search→optional non-generative rerank→diversity-selection tool path; the retrieval and dialogue pipelines share vector, user-profile, and session state. Each sync uses stable IDs, full hashes, and semantic hashes to distinguish new, semantically changed, metadata-only, deleted, and unchanged products and processes only the delta; on an anonymized 500-item catalogue, no-change, price/stock, and deletion cases take 1.8%/2.5%/2.1% of full rebuild time, while additions and description/category changes take 11.0%/12.3%. The paper provides a live WhatsApp demo but explicitly limits evaluation to synchronization correctness and cost rather than recommendation quality, leaving offline relevance and user studies for future work.

entries.title: Personalized Communication Skills for Agentic Recommender Systems
entries.description: AgentCom routes target-user and advisor agents through a reusable why–what–how–who communication skill bank, then evolves the bank from failed interactions to repair missing preference evidence.

details.abstractZh: AgentCom 针对 UserAgent 仅依赖个人有限历史导致的视角收窄，引入目标用户 Agent 与顾问用户 Agent 的个性化协作。共享技能库按 why–what–how–who 四层描述何时需要沟通、询问什么、采用何种协议以及选择谁，并通过个性化技能路由组织通信路径，再从失败交互中演化新技能。实验在 LastFM、Epinions、LibraryThing 上覆盖 SASRec、GBSR、AFL、iAgent、MemRec；加入 AgentCom 后所有 backbone 的 Hit@1 均提升，其中 MemRec 的相对提升分别为 1.8%、2.4% 和 8.4%。
details.abstractEn: AgentCom addresses perspective narrowing in UserAgents by coordinating a target-user agent with advisor-user agents. Its shared why–what–how–who bank represents when communication is needed, what evidence to seek, how to interact, and whom to consult; personalized routing assembles a path, while failed interactions evolve reusable skills. Experiments on LastFM, Epinions, and LibraryThing cover SASRec, GBSR, AFL, iAgent, and MemRec; AgentCom improves Hit@1 for every backbone, including relative MemRec gains of 1.8%, 2.4%, and 8.4%.

entries.title: ReasonRec: A Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Unified Recommendation
institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
entries.description: Observe→Deliberate→Act multimodal recommender agent: VLM encoding, reasoning-aware instruction tuning, and uncertainty-triggered tool delegation to a lightweight external recommender.

details.abstractZh: ReasonRec 提出了一种以 Observe→Deliberate→Act 为架构的多模态推荐 Agent：Observe 阶段用视觉语言模型对文本、图像和用户历史进行表征；Deliberate 阶段通过推理感知视觉指令微调和思维链做显式推理；Act 阶段依据不确定性判断是否将困难样本委派给轻量级传统推荐工具。在 sequential recommendation、direct recommendation、CTR prediction 和 explanation generation 四类任务及五个真实数据集上，相对强多模态基线在 HR@5、NDCG@5 等关键排序指标上的相对提升超过 30%。该工作将工具委派从固定流程改造为置信度/不确定性触发的自适应行为。
details.abstractEn: ReasonRec builds a multimodal recommender agent with an Observe→Deliberate→Act architecture: Observe encodes text, images, and user history via VLM; Deliberate applies reasoning-aware visual instruction tuning with CoT for explicit reasoning; Act delegates uncertain hard samples to a lightweight external recommender tool based on confidence/uncertainty. Covering four task types and five real-world datasets, the approach reports over 30% relative improvement on key ranking metrics (HR@5, NDCG@5) compared to strong multimodal baselines, turning tool delegation from a fixed pipeline step into confidence-triggered adaptive behavior.

entries.title: Seeing and Reflecting: Multimodal Memory-Enhanced Agent Collaboration for Recommendation
institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
The University of New South Wales
entries.description: MMEACR coordinates persistent User and Item Memory Agents with attribute-guided reinforcement/reflection, preserves raw cross-modal evidence in a parallel embedding memory, and fuses both rankings via reciprocal rank fusion.

details.abstractZh: MMEACR 用双轨记忆解决推荐 Agent 的文本中心化与粗粒度更新问题。推理轨由 User Memory Agent 与 Item Memory Agent 维护持久语义状态，并在正负物品交互后通过属性引导的 reinforcement-and-reflection 更新用户与物品记忆；匹配轨保留原始交互叙事和物品图像的细粒度多模态 embedding，最终以加权 RRF 融合两路排名。实验在 Amazon Reviews 的 CDs、Cell Phones 与 Fashion 三个域上、每域 100 用户和 500 次交互、五个随机种子评测；相对最强基线，MMEACR-RRF 在 Cell Phones 的 NDCG@1/@5 提升 14.3%/21.26%，在 Fashion 的 NDCG@1/@5 与 MRR 提升 45.45%/23.33%/27.14%。
details.abstractEn: MMEACR addresses text-centric and coarse-grained memory updates in recommendation agents with a dual-track design. In the reasoning track, persistent User and Item Memory Agents update semantic states after positive/negative item interactions through attribute-guided reinforcement and reflection; the matching track preserves fine-grained multimodal evidence from raw interaction narratives and item images, and weighted reciprocal rank fusion combines both rankings. Experiments on the Amazon Reviews CDs, Cell Phones, and Fashion domains use 100 users and 500 interactions per domain over five random seeds; versus the strongest baseline, MMEACR-RRF improves NDCG@1/@5 by 14.3%/21.26% on Cell Phones and improves NDCG@1/@5 and MRR by 45.45%/23.33%/27.14% on Fashion.

entries.title: EvoRec: Self Evolving Agentic Recommender Systems
entries.description: An Orchestrator coordinates research, code, and skill-evolution agents across hypothesis, implementation, training, validation, and structured experience write-back for continual recommender improvement.

details.abstractZh: EvoRec 由 Orchestrator 编排 Research Agent、Code Agent 与 Skill Evolver，把推荐系统迭代组织成 hypothesis→代码修改→训练→验证→结构化轨迹持久化的闭环；每五轮从成功、失败和中性记录中蒸馏 Research、Engineering、Diagnosis 三类技能。离线实验覆盖 Amazon Books 与一个约 29.5 亿交互、1470 万用户、2010 万物品的东南亚工业电商数据集，对 MGUI 和 REG4Rec 最多自迭代 50 轮，最高相对最强基线提升 5.54%。广告推荐平台七天线上 A/B 报告 revenue +1.85%、CTR +1.02%（双侧检验 p<0.05）；去掉 Skill Evolution、Memory 或外部知识会使工业数据上的 Evo-MGUI R@10 分别下降 2.10%、3.50% 和 1.58%。
details.abstractEn: EvoRec has an Orchestrator coordinate Research, Code, and Skill-Evolution agents through a hypothesis→code modification→training→validation→structured trajectory persistence loop; every five rounds, successful, failed, and neutral records are distilled into Research, Engineering, and Diagnosis skills. Offline evaluation covers Amazon Books and an industrial Southeast Asian e-commerce dataset with roughly 2.95 billion interactions, 14.7 million users, and 20.1 million items, self-iterating MGUI and REG4Rec for up to 50 rounds and reaching a maximum 5.54% relative gain over the strongest baseline. A seven-day online A/B test on an advertising recommender reports +1.85% revenue and +1.02% CTR (two-sided p<0.05); removing Skill Evolution, Memory, or external knowledge lowers industrial Evo-MGUI R@10 by 2.10%, 3.50%, and 1.58%, respectively.

entries.title: MARS: Agentic Recommender System with Hierarchical Belief-State Memory
entries.description: Models recommendation as a partially observable problem; divides agent memory into event→preference→profile three-layer belief state with six explicit lifecycle operations managed by an LLM planner.

details.abstractZh: MARS 将长期推荐建模为部分可观测问题，把 Agent 记忆显式划分为 event memory → preference memory → profile memory 三层 belief state，并由 LLM planner 决定何时执行提取、强化、弱化、整合、遗忘与重合成六类生命周期操作。在四个 InstructRec benchmark 领域上，相对最强基线平均 HR@1 +26.4%、NDCG@10 +10.3%，在偏好持续变化的设定下 agentic scheduling 还能带来额外收益。这一工作代表 2026 年的关键转向：记忆不再是简单追加历史，而是带有显式衰减、强化、遗忘与抽象层级的状态管理系统。
details.abstractEn: MARS models long-horizon recommendation as a partially observable problem, explicitly dividing agent memory into event→preference→profile three-layer belief state. An LLM planner decides when to execute six lifecycle operations: extraction, reinforcement, weakening, consolidation, forgetting, and resynthesis. Across four InstructRec benchmark domains, it reports average HR@1 +26.4% and NDCG@10 +10.3% relative to the strongest baseline, with agentic scheduling yielding additional gains in preference-shift settings. This work represents a key 2026 shift: memory is no longer simple append-to-history but a state management system with explicit decay, reinforcement, forgetting, and abstraction layers.

entries.title: MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System
entries.description: Reconstructs cross-user collaborative signals as a semantic memory graph; decouples memory management (lightweight LM_Mem) from reasoning and reranking (high-capability LLM_Rec) with asynchronous propagation.

details.abstractZh: MemRec 将传统协同过滤的跨用户信号重构为协同语义记忆图，并把“”护记忆“”“”记忆推理推荐“”给不同语言模型：轻量 LM_Mem 负责检索、压缩和异步传播记忆，高能力 LLM_Rec 只接收已精炼的高信号上下文进行重排序，从而避免单一 Agent 同时吞下大量邻居历史再推理的开销。在 Books、Goodreads、MovieTV、Yelp 四个 benchmark 上，相比各数据集最强基线的 H@1 相对提升分别为 14.91%、28.98%、19.75%、15.77%，NDCG@5 相对提升约为 7.54%、11.51%、11.24%、7.59%，均具有统计显著性。
details.abstractEn: MemRec reconstructs cross-user collaborative signals as a collaborative semantic memory graph and decouples memory management (lightweight LM_Mem handles retrieval, compression, and asynchronous propagation) from reasoning/reranking (high-capability LLM_Rec receives only curated high-signal context), avoiding the overhead of a monolithic agent processing all neighbor history. On Books, Goodreads, MovieTV, and Yelp, H@1 relative improvements vs strongest baseline are 14.91%, 28.98%, 19.75%, and 15.77%; NDCG@5 improvements are 7.54%, 11.51%, 11.24%, and 7.59%, all statistically significant.

entries.title: AgenticRec: Recommendation-Oriented Agentic Framework with Progressive Tool-Integrated Reasoning Optimization
entries.description: Embeds recommendation-specific tools in a ReAct-style loop; trajectory-level RL with ranking reward trains the entire reasoning→tool invocation→observation→ranking chain; Progressive Preference Refinement mines hard negatives from ranking violations.

details.abstractZh: AgenticRec 将推荐专用工具嵌入 ReAct 式循环，并将最终排名奖励反向用于训练整条 reasoning → tool invocation → observation → ranking 轨迹，而非仅训练最后的排序 token。框架通过 recommendation-oriented trajectory optimization/RL 学习何时调用工具；Progressive Preference Refinement (PPR) 从排名违例中挖掘困难负样本以强化细粒度偏好边界。实验使用 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 CDs、Musical Instruments、Office Products、Video Games 四个子集，backbone 为 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507；在 20 个 dataset×metric 组合中的 19 个取得最优结果。关键 ablation 表明：未经训练的工具调用在部分数据上会引入噪声，经 trajectory-level RL 后工具集成 Agent 才稳定超越纯推理模型，说明工具使用策略的训练才是收益来源。
details.abstractEn: AgenticRec embeds recommendation-specific tools in a ReAct-style loop and uses trajectory-level RL with ranking reward to train the full reasoning→tool invocation→observation→ranking trajectory rather than only the final ranking token. Progressive Preference Refinement (PPR) mines hard negatives from ranking violations to strengthen fine-grained preference boundaries. Experiments on four Amazon Reviews 2023 subsets (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 backbone) achieve best results on 19 of 20 dataset×metric cells. Key ablation shows: untrained tool calls introduce noise on some datasets; only after trajectory-level RL does the tool-integrated agent consistently surpass pure-reasoning models, proving that training the tool-use policy — not merely providing tools — is the source of gains.

entries.title: RecThinker: An Agentic Framework for Tool-Augmented Reasoning in Recommendation
entries.description: RecThinker runs an Analyze→Plan→Act investigation loop over five recommendation-specific tools, then uses self-augmented SFT and GRPO with accuracy, format, and tool-efficiency rewards to refine complete tool-use trajectories.

details.abstractZh: RecThinker 把推荐从被动读取现有画像改造成主动调查：Agent 先分析用户与候选物品的信息缺口，再规划并迭代调用 profile、history、similar-user、item 与 knowledge-graph 五类专用工具，最后基于累计证据完成排序。训练先从高质量推理—工具轨迹做 self-augmented SFT，再以 GRPO 联合优化 NDCG@10、格式正确性与工具效率。实验覆盖 Amazon CD & Vinyl 和 MovieLens-1M 的稀疏/稠密四个 100 用户子集，采用 1 正 9 负的 leave-one-out 排名；RecThinker 在四组 NDCG@10 上相对最强基线分别提升 11.71%、10.57%、7.61% 和 11.79%。
details.abstractEn: RecThinker turns recommendation from passive profile consumption into active investigation: the agent analyzes information gaps for users and candidate items, plans and iteratively calls five specialized tools for profiles, history, similar users, items, and knowledge graphs, then ranks from the accumulated evidence. Training first applies self-augmented SFT to high-quality reasoning/tool trajectories and then GRPO with rewards for NDCG@10, format correctness, and tool efficiency. Evaluation covers sparse and dense 100-user subsets of Amazon CD & Vinyl and MovieLens-1M with leave-one-out ranking over one positive and nine negatives; relative NDCG@10 gains over the strongest baseline are 11.71%, 10.57%, 7.61%, and 11.79% across the four settings.

entries.title: TAIRA: Thought-Augmented Planning for LLM-Powered Interactive Recommender Agent
entries.description: Multi-agent interactive recommendation: a Manager Agent decomposes complex user intents into subtasks; Thought Pattern Distillation (TPD) extracts high-level thinking patterns from agent history and human expert experience to strengthen planning.

details.abstractZh: TAIRA 是 2025 年正文中最直接的多 Agent 交互推荐路线之一：多 Agent 系统由 manager agent 解析复杂/含糊的用户意图、分解推荐任务并规划子任务，再通过 Thought Pattern Distillation (TPD) 从 Agent 历史经验和人类专家经验中抽取高层思维模式来强化规划。论文设计不同难度的用户仿真查询，在多个推荐数据集上测试；作者报告 TAIRA 对现有方法有显著优势，且请求越复杂，优势越明显，并能迁移到新的任务类型。
details.abstractEn: TAIRA is one of the most direct multi-agent interactive recommendation approaches in 2025: a Manager Agent parses complex and ambiguous user intents, decomposes recommendation tasks into subtasks, and plans their execution; Thought Pattern Distillation (TPD) extracts high-level thinking patterns from agent history and human expert experience to strengthen planning. Experiments with user simulation queries of varying difficulty across multiple recommendation datasets show TAIRA significantly outperforms existing methods, with advantages growing with query complexity, and generalizing to new task types.

entries.title: ECPO: Expectation Confirmation Preference Optimization for Multi-Turn Conversational Recommendation Agent
entries.description: Refines multi-turn conversational recommendation preference optimization to turn-level expectation confirmation; introduces AILO user agent simulating Activities/Interests/Language/Orientations; avoids expensive conversation-tree sampling via Backward Expectation Derivation.

details.abstractZh: ECPO 把多轮对话推荐的偏好优化从“”条对话最终打分“”化到 turn-level expectation confirmation。CRA 本身使用可调 LLM，并利用 planning 与 tool-calling 在对话中进行偏好获取和外部 item retrieval；同时引入另一个 LLM 用户 Agent AILO，模拟用户 Activities、Interests、Language、Orientations，并对每轮回答执行 expectation confirmation。训练流程包括 Simulator-Guided Planning Tuning、Forward Expectation Confirmation、Backward Expectation Derivation 和 Preference Optimization，目的之一是避免传统多轮偏好优化在每个节点扩展大量对话树的采样开销。
details.abstractEn: ECPO refines multi-turn conversational recommendation preference optimization from whole-conversation final scoring to turn-level expectation confirmation. The CRA uses a tunable LLM with planning and tool-calling for preference elicitation and external item retrieval; a second LLM user agent AILO simulates user Activities, Interests, Language, and Orientations and performs expectation confirmation per turn. The training pipeline — Simulator-Guided Planning Tuning, Forward Expectation Confirmation, Backward Expectation Derivation, and Preference Optimization — aims to avoid the expensive conversation-tree sampling overhead of traditional multi-turn preference optimization.

entries.title: PersonaX: A Recommendation Agent-Oriented User Modeling Framework for Long Behavior Sequence
entries.description: Solves context-length and latency bottlenecks by offline-clustering long behavior sequences into multi-persona profiles cached for online agent retrieval; using only 30–50% of behaviors improves AgentCF by 3–11% and Agent4Rec by 10–50%.

details.abstractZh: PersonaX 用离线的多人格记忆/画像层解决长行为序列对推荐 Agent 的上下文长度、信息丢失和在线延迟问题。它先将完整行为聚类，再选择兼顾代表性与多样性的多段子行为序列，离线生成多个细粒度 persona 并缓存，线上 Agent 直接检索 persona 而不需每次实时重建 profile。在长度约 480 的行为序列上，仅使用 30%–50% 的行为数据，PersonaX 就能使 AgentCF 提升约 3%–11%，使 Agent4Rec 提升约 10%–50%。这说明 2025 年“”户画像 Agent 化“”重点已从简单摘要转向压缩、检索、缓存和多兴趣分解。
details.abstractEn: PersonaX addresses context-length, information-loss, and online-latency bottlenecks for recommendation agents via an offline multi-persona memory/profile layer. It clusters full behavior sequences, selects representative and diverse sub-sequences, generates fine-grained personas offline and caches them; the online agent retrieves personas directly without real-time profile reconstruction. On sequences of ~480 length using only 30–50% of the behavior data, PersonaX improves AgentCF by ~3–11% and Agent4Rec by ~10–50%, demonstrating that 2025's 'user-profile agentification' focus has shifted from simple summarization to compression, retrieval, caching, and multi-interest decomposition.

entries.title: iAgent: LLM Agent as a Shield between User and Recommender Systems
entries.description: Places a user-side personal agent between user and platform; i²Agent adds instruction-aware parser and dynamic memory continuously reconstructing user profiles from feedback for reranking, achieving average +16.6% on ranking metrics vs EasyRec.

details.abstractZh: iAgent 不再把 Agent 仅视为平台方的推荐增强模块，而是在用户与平台之间放入一个用户侧个人 Agent，由 Agent 解析用户指令、维护偏好并重新组织平台输出，形成 user–agent–platform 范式。增强版 i²Agent 引入 instruction-aware parser 与 dynamic memory，根据反馈持续重构用户 profile，再用于重排序；这一设计本质上把“”户画像“”静态 prompt 变成持续演化的 Agent state。在论文实验中，i²Agent 相比第二强基线 EasyRec，标准排名指标平均提升约 16.6%；作者还将 echo chamber 减弱、广告过滤、活跃/低活跃用户效用等纳入评价。
details.abstractEn: iAgent reframes the agent's role from a platform-side recommendation enhancer to a user-side personal agent placed between user and platform, parsing user instructions, maintaining preferences, and reorganizing platform output in a user–agent–platform paradigm. The enhanced i²Agent adds an instruction-aware parser and dynamic memory that continuously reconstructs user profiles from feedback for reranking, transforming 'user profiles' from static prompts into continuously evolving agent state. i²Agent achieves average +16.6% on standard ranking metrics vs second-best baseline EasyRec; evaluation also covers echo chamber reduction, ad filtering, and active/low-activity user utility.

entries.title: T-PRA: Tunable LLM-based Proactive Recommendation Agent
entries.description: Reformulates proactive recommendation as long-horizon sequential decision and influence path planning; Actor–Advisor–Critic structure with multi-objective long-term reward and DPO-style agent tuning via preference optimization.

details.abstractZh: T-PRA 把“”动推荐“”一次性 next-item prediction 改写为长期、序列化的决策与影响路径规划问题，让 LLM Agent 根据用户实时反馈不断调整动作。其 Actor–Advisor–Critic 式结构：Actor 负责推荐和决策，Advisor 辅助产生/修正 reasoning，Critic 根据多目标长期 reward 评价轨迹，并利用偏好优化进行 Agent tuning。该工作的重要性在于把推荐 Agent 明确推进到 long-horizon planning + feedback-driven policy tuning，是 2025 年主动推荐方向的代表性 ACL 长文。
details.abstractEn: T-PRA reformulates proactive recommendation from one-shot next-item prediction to long-horizon sequential decision and influence path planning, enabling the LLM agent to continuously adjust actions based on real-time user feedback. Its Actor–Advisor–Critic structure has Actor handle recommendations and decisions, Advisor assist in generating/correcting reasoning, and Critic evaluate trajectories with multi-objective long-term reward; agent tuning uses preference optimization (DPO-style). The significance lies in explicitly advancing recommender agents to long-horizon planning + feedback-driven policy tuning, representing the 2025 ACL flagship work in proactive recommendation.

entries.title: MOSAIC: Query-Aware Exploration Policy Adaptation for GraphRAG
entries.description: An analyzer converts each query into a bounded graph-exploration policy covering seed choice, traversal, cumulative-gain stopping, and evidence selection instead of applying one fixed GraphRAG recipe.

details.abstractZh: MOSAIC 用 LLM Analyzer 在每个问题到来时生成受约束的 GraphRAG 探索策略，联合控制 seed 选择、图遍历、基于累计增益的停止条件和最终证据筛选，并在有限动作空间内校验策略后执行。GraphRAG-Bench 上 query-weighted ACC 在 Medical/Novel 分别达到 76.97/64.33，比最强报告基线高 5.13/4.43 个点；Medical 的 Evidence Recall 与 Context Relevancy 为 95.1/86.1，相比最强固定策略少走 81.9% 路径、少取 47.2% 证据。HotpotQA、MuSiQue 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 迁移实验仍有增益，但方法会引入额外 Analyzer 延迟，且没有生产部署证据。
details.abstractEn: MOSAIC uses an LLM analyzer to synthesize a constrained GraphRAG exploration policy for each query, jointly controlling seed selection, graph traversal, cumulative-gain stopping, and final evidence selection before validating and executing the policy. On GraphRAG-Bench, query-weighted accuracy reaches 76.97 on Medical and 64.33 on Novel, 5.13 and 4.43 points above the strongest reported baselines; Medical evidence recall/context relevancy is 95.1/86.1 while using 81.9% fewer paths and 47.2% fewer evidence items than the strongest fixed policy. Transfer experiments on HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and 2WikiMultiHopQA remain positive, but the analyzer adds latency and no production deployment is reported.

entries.title: VikingRAG: Accurate and Token-efficient Retrieval-augmented Generation over Structured Documents
entries.description: Alternates Search/List/Grep/Read actions over hierarchical documents, writes successful multi-round traces into reusable experience edges, and escalates from one-round retrieval only when an evidence-sufficiency verifier fires.

details.abstractZh: VikingRAG 在结构化文档树上让 Agent 以最多 15 步交替调用 Search、List、Grep 和 Read，并累积证据后作答；历史多轮轨迹被物化为 experience edges，形成可复用的检索 memory，evidence-sufficiency verifier 则只在单轮证据不足时触发昂贵的 agentic path。六个数据集覆盖 VersionQA、SyllabusQA、QASPER、HotpotQA、LegalBench-CUAD 与 FinanceBench，语料最大约 878 万 token，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GPT-5.5、Seed-2.0 和 GLM-4.7。作者报告基础版只消耗对比方法 11.6%–51.9% 的 token，加入 experience 与自适应升级后降至 5.1%–32.5%，但证据来自静态语料和合成 warm-up 问题，尚无线上部署。
details.abstractEn: VikingRAG lets an agent alternate Search, List, Grep, and Read for up to 15 steps over hierarchical document trees, accumulating evidence before answering. Historical multi-round traces are materialized as reusable experience edges, while an evidence-sufficiency verifier invokes the expensive agentic path only when one-round retrieval is inadequate. Evaluation spans VersionQA, SyllabusQA, QASPER, HotpotQA, LegalBench-CUAD, and FinanceBench—up to about 8.78 million tokens—with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GPT-5.5, Seed-2.0, and GLM-4.7. The base system uses 11.6%–51.9% of comparison-method tokens and the experience/adaptive variant 5.1%–32.5%, but evidence is from static corpora and synthetic warm-up questions rather than production.

entries.title: Agentic Share-of-Search: A Multi-Agent AI System for Competitive Decision-Making in LLM-Mediated E-Commerce
institutions: College of Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology
entries.description: A coordinator fans query–platform tasks to retrieval agents, an extraction agent normalizes product mentions, and a ReAct diagnostic agent calls statistical and SOP-validation tools to turn LLM answer visibility into retailer actions.

details.abstractZh: Agentic Share-of-Search 用 Coordinator 将 query–platform 组合分派给 ChatGPT、Perplexity 与 Gemini 查询 Agent，Extraction Agent 解析商品提及，ReAct Diagnostic Agent 再调用相关性分析和 SOP 校验工具，把可见度变化转成运营建议。运行鞋案例包含 23 个 SKU、7 家零售商、34 个查询、3 个平台和 3 次重复，共 306 个回答与 1,524 次提及；100 次合成消融中，目标处于 top-1 时建议精确率为 39%（95% CI 30.0–48.8），进入 top-3 时为 63.9%。真实 pilot 只覆盖 Gemini，仍是可行性原型，跨平台纵向部署、干预效果与更大规模人工标注尚未完成。
details.abstractEn: Agentic Share-of-Search has a coordinator dispatch query–platform pairs to ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini agents, an extraction agent normalize product mentions, and a ReAct diagnostic agent call correlation and SOP-validation tools to convert visibility changes into retailer actions. Its running-shoes study covers 23 SKUs, seven retailers, 34 queries, three platforms, and three repetitions—306 responses and 1,524 mentions; across 100 synthetic ablation trials, recommendation precision is 39% (95% CI 30.0–48.8) when the target ranks first and 63.9% when it reaches the top three. The live pilot is Gemini-only and remains a feasibility prototype without longitudinal multi-platform deployment or measured intervention effects.

entries.title: SearchAtlas: Analyzing Agentic Search Strategies via Evidential Query Graphs
entries.description: Converts complete search traces into evidential query DAGs that attribute which searches support which conclusions, enabling structural comparison and failure diagnosis across agent families.

details.abstractZh: SearchAtlas 把完整搜索轨迹解析成 evidential query DAG：节点表示 query/claim，边表示某次检索对后续结论的证据贡献，从而把只看最终答案的评测扩展为搜索结构、证据复用和失败路径诊断。框架分析五种搜索 Agent、三个基准与 1,350 条轨迹，并用 100 张人工标注图评估归因质量；四种 LLM 解析器的 macro edge F1 为 0.814–0.860，基于图特征的成功/失败诊断 ROC-AUC 为 0.840–0.856。不同系统的中位节点/边数从 6/7 到 103/165、深度从 2 到 26、多来源比例从 8% 到 39%；它是事后分析框架而非新搜索策略，结果也依赖自动证据归因。
details.abstractEn: SearchAtlas parses complete search trajectories into evidential query DAGs whose nodes represent queries or claims and whose edges attribute which searches support later conclusions, extending endpoint evaluation to search structure, evidence reuse, and failure-path diagnosis. It analyzes five search agents over three benchmarks and 1,350 trajectories, with 100 human-annotated graphs for attribution quality; four LLM parsers achieve macro edge F1 of 0.814–0.860, and graph-feature failure diagnosis reaches ROC-AUC 0.840–0.856. Median nodes/edges range from 6/7 to 103/165, depth from 2 to 26, and multi-source rates from 8% to 39%. This is a post-hoc analysis framework rather than a new search policy, and conclusions depend on automated evidence attribution.

entries.title: RAP: Research Attention Prediction Reveals Target-Conditioned Evidence Acquisition Biases
institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
entries.description: Places forecasting agents in temporally restricted arXiv search environments and uses frozen-evidence replay to expose how target-conditioned retrieval choices bias downstream research-attention predictions.

details.abstractZh: RAP 让 Agent 只能搜索预测时点之前可见的 arXiv 论文，再预测八个研究方向未来六个月的关注分布，并通过 closed、fixed-window 与 expanding-history 三种证据访问制度以及 frozen-evidence replay，把搜索策略效应与预测模型效应分离。基准覆盖 278 个研究领域和 1,390 个 rolling episodes；对 Qwen3-4B 做 outcome-aligned fine-tuning 后，预测 Spearman correlation 提升 0.105，而在 exact-history 设置中只有重新开放 Search 的 GPT-5.5 略超 exact-count EWMA。它研究的是科学检索轨迹如何影响预测，不是通用排序器；arXiv 提交份额只是 attention proxy，八方向 codebook 不是专家 taxonomy，且只有 Forecast-Strict 设置能支持真正的未见未来结论。
details.abstractEn: RAP restricts an agent to arXiv papers available before each forecast date and asks it to predict the next six-month attention distribution over eight research directions. Closed, fixed-window, and expanding-history access regimes plus frozen-evidence replay separate search-policy effects from forecasting effects. The benchmark contains 278 fields and 1,390 rolling episodes; outcome-aligned fine-tuning of Qwen3-4B improves forecast Spearman correlation by 0.105, while only GPT-5.5 with reopened Search slightly exceeds the exact-count EWMA baseline under exact history. The work studies how scientific-search trajectories bias prediction rather than proposing a general ranker; arXiv share is only an attention proxy, the eight-way codebooks are not expert taxonomies, and only Forecast-Strict supports unseen-future claims.

entries.title: Beyond One-Shot Expansion: Contrastive Evidence Exploration for Multi-Hop Retrieval
entries.description: Runs four evidence-conditioned retrieval rounds, generating probes for unresolved information needs and selecting complementary passages with coverage-aware contrastive facets.

details.abstractZh: 该方法把一次性 query expansion 改造成四轮 evidence exploration：每轮先总结已取证内容，再针对尚未解决的信息缺口和新暴露的 bridge entities 生成 probe，用 passage-specific contrastive facets 细化候选，并以 coverage-aware 贪心选择避免重复证据。MuSiQue 的 FSR@10 从最佳基线 39.20 提升至 57.00，2WikiMultihopQA 从 75.60 提升至 91.50，HotpotQA 从 93.30 提升至 96.20；移除 sequential exploration 后 MuSiQue FSR@10 由 57.00 降到 36.50。结果来自三个固定多跳 QA 语料、单一文本编码器和 probe LLM、固定四轮检索，没有 live-Web 环境，因此更适合作为迭代取证机制证据而非线上部署结论。
details.abstractEn: The method replaces one-shot query expansion with four rounds of evidence exploration. Each round summarizes accumulated evidence, generates probes for unresolved needs and newly exposed bridge entities, refines candidates with passage-specific contrastive facets, and greedily selects complementary evidence under coverage control. FSR@10 rises from the strongest baseline's 39.20 to 57.00 on MuSiQue, 75.60 to 91.50 on 2WikiMultihopQA, and 93.30 to 96.20 on HotpotQA; removing sequential exploration drops MuSiQue FSR@10 from 57.00 to 36.50. Evidence is limited to three fixed multi-hop QA corpora, one encoder and probe LLM, and four retrieval rounds without a live-Web environment.

entries.title: Evaluating Deep-Search Agents under Hierarchical Web Evidence Poisoning
entries.description: HAE-GEO evaluates complete search trajectories in paired clean and poisoned Web environments, tracking whether agents expose, adopt, verify, recover from, or endorse false evidence.

details.abstractZh: HAE-GEO 把深度搜索安全评测从最终答案扩展到 exposure→adoption→verification→recovery→endorsement 完整轨迹：Agent 在成对的 clean/poisoned 环境中执行最多十轮 Search、Scrape 和 Answer 动作，并可通过自适应 query 查找此前未见来源来纠错。环境包含 72,039 个干净网页，并在每个攻击强度下加入 770 个 poisoned pages，覆盖八类产品、154 个品牌；主评测使用 120 个问题和十个模型家族。该研究提供的是受控检索环境中的诊断基准，而非新的生产搜索器；问题子集固定，poisoning 操纵事实证据但不包含 prompt injection，因此不能覆盖开放 Web 的全部攻击面。
details.abstractEn: HAE-GEO extends deep-search safety evaluation from final answers to the full exposure→adoption→verification→recovery→endorsement trajectory. Agents take up to ten Search, Scrape, and Answer rounds in paired clean and poisoned environments and may issue adaptive verification queries to inspect previously unseen sources. The environment contains 72,039 clean pages plus 770 poisoned pages per attack level across eight product categories and 154 brands; the main evaluation covers 120 queries and ten model families. This is a diagnostic benchmark in a controlled retrieval environment rather than a new production searcher; the subset is fixed and poisoning alters factual evidence without prompt injection, so it does not cover the full open-Web threat surface.

entries.title: ITER: Interaction-Aware Retrieval for Agentic Search
entries.description: Trains a retriever on full agent interaction state and trajectory-relative positives, redundancy negatives, and hard negatives so later searches account for prior queries and visited evidence.

details.abstractZh: ITER 不再把每次 retrieval 当作孤立 query：编码器联合表示主问题、当前 subquery 和此前 subqueries，并从成功 Agent 轨迹中构造 step-specific positives、分层 redundancy negatives、hard/weak negatives，以加权对比目标训练 interaction-aware retriever。训练数据由 InfoSeek 的 10,000 个问题和四种 retriever 产生 40,000 条轨迹，保留 20,893 条成功轨迹、67,934 个正样本对；在六种 Agent backbone 上评测 InfoSeek-Eval 与 BrowseComp-Plus，Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B 的任务成功率分别为 80.0 和 46.6，对比 LRAT 的 72.7/43.4 及 current-query-only 的 76.7/43.7，12 个组合中 7 个达到显著差异。它只训练固定 ranked interface 后的 retriever，标签依赖 Qwen judge 且仅从成功轨迹学习，实验也使用固定语料，不能等同于端到端 Agent 或 live-Web 部署。
details.abstractEn: ITER stops treating retrieval steps as isolated queries. Its encoder jointly represents the main question, current subquery, and prior subqueries, and trains with weighted contrastive learning over step-specific positives, tiered redundancy negatives, and hard or weak negatives mined from successful agent trajectories. From 40,000 trajectories generated for 10,000 InfoSeek questions with four retrievers, it retains 20,893 successful trajectories and 67,934 positive pairs; across six agent backbones on InfoSeek-Eval and BrowseComp-Plus, Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B reaches 80.0 and 46.6 task success versus LRAT's 72.7/43.4 and current-query-only retrieval's 76.7/43.7, with significance in seven of 12 comparisons. The method trains only the retriever behind a fixed ranked interface, depends on a Qwen judge and successful trajectories, and uses fixed corpora rather than an end-to-end live-Web deployment.

entries.title: Headroom-Drift Replay: A Primitive for Principled Replay Control in GRPO
institutions: Department of Artificial Intelligence, Sogang University
entries.description: Separates replay control into Headroom-based learning-value prioritization and Policy-Drift compatibility gating, reusing full search-trajectory groups to reduce costly fresh environment interaction.

details.abstractZh: Headroom-Drift Replay 针对搜索 Agent 的 GRPO 训练中环境交互耗时高、历史轨迹易过时的问题，把 replay 拆成两个独立控制量：Headroom 按剩余学习价值排序完整 rollout group，Policy Drift 则过滤与当前策略不兼容的旧轨迹。Search-R1 实验覆盖 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 和 Bamboogle；3B 设置下相对扩大 fresh rollout 的 on-policy GRPO，Avg Mean@32 从 0.3212 提升至 0.3577，同时单步时间从 197.2 秒降至 166.3 秒。7B 单次受控对比中，Avg Mean@4 从普通 replay 的 0.3737 提升到 0.3955，并在七个基准中的六个领先；论文已被 COLM 2026 接收，但作者明确说明该 7B 比较每种方法只有一次运行。
details.abstractEn: Headroom-Drift Replay addresses expensive environment interaction and stale trajectories in GRPO-trained search agents by splitting replay into two controls: Headroom ranks complete rollout groups by remaining learning value, while Policy Drift rejects groups incompatible with the current policy. Search-R1 experiments cover NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle; in the 3B setting, it improves Avg Mean@32 from 0.3212 for larger-budget on-policy GRPO to 0.3577 while reducing mean step time from 197.2 to 166.3 seconds. In a single-run controlled 7B comparison, Avg Mean@4 rises from 0.3737 with ordinary replay to 0.3955 and leads on six of seven benchmarks; the paper is accepted at COLM 2026, but explicitly limits that 7B comparison to one run per method.

entries.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
entries.description: NIS-Agent isolates webpage triage from accumulated context, rewrites queries when evidence is weak, and independently validates premise-to-conclusion steps before the manager continues or terminates research.

details.abstractZh: NIS-Agent 针对长程搜索中错误证据被上下文惯性反复放大的问题，构建 Manager–Worker 深度研究闭环：SearchAgent 在隔离上下文中判断网页相关性，证据不足时自适应改写 query；ManagerAgent 重组执行历史，并独立验证 premise→conclusion 推理链后决定继续检索或终止。论文还以 SFT+GRPO 训练 NIS-8B 的检索后工具决策，在 GAIA 全量验证集及 WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp、BrowseComp-zh 子集上评测；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 配置的 GAIA/WebWalkerQA 为 81.21/75.00，GPT-4o 配置在 GAIA 上把每题总 token 从 219.8k 降至 147.3k（-33.0%）。GPT-4o 消融中完整系统为 61.82，去掉隔离过滤或独立验证后分别降至 59.39 和 56.96；这些均为作者报告结果。
details.abstractEn: NIS-Agent addresses context inertia in long-horizon search with a manager–worker deep-research loop. Its SearchAgent triages webpages in an isolated context and adaptively rewrites the query when evidence is insufficient, while the ManagerAgent reorganizes execution history and independently validates premise-to-conclusion steps before continuing or terminating. The paper also trains NIS-8B with SFT plus GRPO for post-search tool decisions and evaluates on the full GAIA validation set plus WebWalkerQA, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-zh samples; the DeepSeek-V4-Pro configuration reports 81.21 on GAIA and 75.00 on WebWalkerQA, while the GPT-4o configuration reduces GAIA tokens per query from 219.8k to 147.3k (−33.0%). In GPT-4o ablations, the full system scores 61.82 versus 59.39 without the isolated filter and 56.96 without independent validation; all figures are author-reported.

entries.title: Spurious Advantage Hidden in GRPO
entries.description: Identifies guess-driven spurious advantage in outcome-only GRPO for multi-turn search and replaces count-dependent magnitudes with SignBalance's globally scaled, per-class-balanced estimator.

details.abstractZh: 该工作指出，使用终点 exact-match 奖励的多轮搜索 Agent 会把通过猜测得到正确答案的轨迹与真正有效的 query/action 路径赋予相同 GRPO advantage magnitude，搜索预算越大，这种 spurious advantage 越容易被放大。SignBalance 保留 verifier 的正负号，以全局尺度替代组内计数依赖，并用 stop-gradient 的分类重标定恢复零均值平衡；Search-R1 设定使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、最多四次搜索调用，并在六个单跳/多跳 QA 基准上评测。其 Avg-6 exact-match 为 37.80，高于 StepSearch 的 36.44 和 Search-R1 的 36.00；2WikiMultiHopQA 相对 Search-R1 从 27.58 提升至 35.20，但 MuSiQue 仍落后于采用 step-level reward shaping 的 StepSearch。
details.abstractEn: This work shows that multi-turn search agents trained with endpoint exact-match rewards give the same GRPO advantage magnitude to trajectories that guess the correct answer and trajectories that follow effective query/action paths, with larger search budgets increasing the surface for this spurious advantage. SignBalance retains the verifier sign, replaces group-composition-dependent magnitude with a global scale, and restores zero-mean balance through stop-gradient per-class rescaling; its Search-R1 setting uses Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, up to four search calls, and six single- and multi-hop QA benchmarks. It reaches 37.80 Avg-6 exact match versus 36.44 for StepSearch and 36.00 for Search-R1, improving 2WikiMultiHopQA from Search-R1's 27.58 to 35.20, while still trailing StepSearch on MuSiQue where step-level reward shaping is used.

entries.title: SciLENS: RL-Driven Autonomous Agents for Scientific Localized Evidence Navigation and Synthesis
institutions: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Science and Technology of China
entries.description: A fully local scientific-search agent navigates 12 million records with a 12-tool research environment, citation-graph planning, structural visualization actions, and evidence-grounded process rewards.

details.abstractZh: SciLENS 在约 1200 万条论文记录的本地 MongoDB、BM25、citation tracking 与分布式 FAISS 环境中运行连续 thought→action→observation 搜索循环，并把检索、引用图遍历、指标整理和经 schema 校验的结构图生成统一为 12 个工具。Qwen3-30B-A3B 先在约 2 万条由 DeepSeek-V3.2 蒸馏且交叉验证的完整轨迹上 SFT，再用强调早期规划和严格证据落地的 rubric process reward 做 RL。六个科学搜索/推理/结构综合基准、五次运行中，QASA/SciFact/PubMedQA/ScholarQA-CS correctness 为 47.62/88.94/77.53/73.98，SSB/SciFR overall 为 0.7607/0.7594；去掉 retrieval 与 graph 后相应六项降至 7.15/15.12/11.05/6.21/0.1902/0.1144。
details.abstractEn: SciLENS runs a continuous thought→action→observation search loop over a fully local environment of roughly 12 million papers backed by MongoDB, BM25, citation tracking, and distributed FAISS, exposing retrieval, citation-graph traversal, metric structuring, and schema-validated visualization through 12 tools. A Qwen3-30B-A3B policy is first SFT-trained on about 20,000 complete DeepSeek-V3.2-distilled and cross-verified trajectories, then optimized with rubric process rewards emphasizing early planning and strict evidence grounding. Across six scientific search, reasoning, and structural-synthesis benchmarks over five runs, QASA/SciFact/PubMedQA/ScholarQA-CS correctness is 47.62/88.94/77.53/73.98 and SSB/SciFR overall is 0.7607/0.7594; removing retrieval and graph capabilities drops the same six scores to 7.15/15.12/11.05/6.21/0.1902/0.1144.

entries.title: CAFE: Self-Improving Search Agents Need Co-Evolving Feedback
entries.description: A shared-parameter model alternates between search-agent and critic roles; online RL learns when feedback is worth requesting and how to use it, while rollout-matched preference optimization makes the critic co-evolve with the policy.

details.abstractZh: CAFE 把搜索 Agent 与反馈 Critic 视为必须共同演化的两个角色，并由同一参数模型交替承担。在线阶段用 call–skip 成功差估计反馈价值，并对反馈前后的 token advantage 分段整形；离线阶段从匹配的成功/失败 rollout 中学习纠正性反馈偏好，使 Critic 随 Agent 错误分布变化。方法只在 2WikiMultihopQA 上训练，并在 HotpotQA、MuSiQue、PopQA、Bamboogle、Natural Questions、TriviaQA 六个域外基准验证；完整配置的七基准平均 EM/F1 达 51.9/60.3，优于相同初始化与预算的 49.7/58.0。
details.abstractEn: CAFE treats the search agent and feedback critic as two roles that must co-evolve, alternating them within one shared-parameter model. Online training estimates feedback value from a call-versus-skip success gap and shapes token advantages before and after feedback; offline matched successful/failed rollouts train corrective preferences as the policy's failure distribution changes. Trained only on 2WikiMultihopQA and tested on six out-of-domain benchmarks, the full configuration reaches 51.9 average EM and 60.3 F1 across seven benchmarks, versus 49.7/58.0 under the same initialization and budget.

entries.title: CAS: Conformalized Agentic Search via Adaptive Retrieval and Policy Weighting
institutions: State Key Laboratory of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University
entries.description: CAS interleaves reasoning and search with conformal adaptive document sets, then uses online conformal confidence to down-weight unreliable complete trajectories inside GRPO.

details.abstractZh: CAS 针对搜索 Agent 在 RL 中的两类可靠性问题——固定 top-k 丢证据/引噪声，以及策略逐渐过度自信后产生幻觉和冗余搜索——把 conformal prediction 同时接入检索与训练。每轮 `<search>` 后，Adaptive Prediction Set 根据当前查询难度动态截断文档并保证目标覆盖；完整 reasoning→search→observation→answer 轨迹进入 GRPO 时，Adaptive Conformal Inference 根据答案 token 的 NLL 动态识别低置信轨迹并降低其策略权重。方法在 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2Wiki、MuSiQue、Bamboogle 七个基准评测：Qwen2.5-3B 的平均 EM 从 Search-R1 的 0.336 提升到 0.401，Qwen3-8B 达 0.464，高于 Search-R1 的 0.400 和 Search-R2 的 0.446；去掉 ACI 或 APS 后 3B 平均 EM 分别降到 0.384 和 0.389。
details.abstractEn: CAS addresses two reliability failures in RL-trained search agents—evidence loss/noise from fixed top-k retrieval and hallucinated or redundant searches caused by growing policy overconfidence—by applying conformal prediction on both retrieval and training sides. After each `<search>` action, an Adaptive Prediction Set dynamically truncates documents according to query difficulty under a target coverage guarantee; when complete reasoning→search→observation→answer trajectories enter GRPO, Adaptive Conformal Inference uses answer-token NLL to identify and down-weight low-confidence trajectories. Across NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle, Qwen2.5-3B improves average EM from Search-R1's 0.336 to 0.401, while Qwen3-8B reaches 0.464 versus 0.400 for Search-R1 and 0.446 for Search-R2; removing ACI or APS lowers the 3B average to 0.384 or 0.389.

entries.title: Self-Correcting Long-Horizon Search Agents via Tree-Structured Memory
entries.description: ReTree stores source-linked evidence and revision history in a bounded tree; contradictions trigger traceback, evidence replacement, summary regeneration, branch pruning, and resumed search.

details.abstractZh: ReTree 为长程搜索 Agent 构建有来源链接的树状记忆，每个节点保存受限摘要、证据与修订历史，从而避免完整轨迹导致的上下文无限增长。当新证据否定旧结论时，系统回溯到该结论的引入节点，替换过期证据、重生成摘要、剪除受影响分支，再从修复后的状态继续搜索，形成显式 reflection/error-recovery 闭环。论文在 Bamboogle、FRAMES、2Wiki 和 HotpotQA 共 2,149 个问题上用 Qwen3-8B 评测，相对 Full-Trajectory ReAct 的回答准确率最高提升 25.6 个百分点，同时把平均最大单步推理上下文控制在后者的约 66%–79%。
details.abstractEn: ReTree gives long-horizon search agents a source-linked tree memory whose nodes retain bounded summaries, evidence, and revision history, avoiding unbounded full-trajectory context. When new evidence contradicts an earlier claim, the agent traces the claim to its origin, replaces stale evidence, regenerates summaries, prunes affected branches, and resumes search from the repaired state—an explicit reflection and error-recovery loop. With Qwen3-8B on 2,149 questions from Bamboogle, FRAMES, 2Wiki, and HotpotQA, ReTree improves answer accuracy over Full-Trajectory ReAct by up to 25.6 percentage points while limiting average maximum per-step reasoning context to roughly 66–79% of the baseline.

entries.title: LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation
institutions: National Engineering Research Center for Software Engineering
Key Laboratory of High Confidence Software Technologies, Ministry of Education
Center on Frontiers of Computing Studies, Peking University
Peking University Information Technology Institute (Tianjin Binhai)
entries.description: LoongReflect treats reflection as memory control over a reversible trajectory tree; explicit reflect/backtrack actions are trained by answer-masked global-teacher distillation plus outcome-based GRPO with look-ahead coordination.

details.abstractZh: LoongReflect 将长程搜索中的 reflection 定义为对可逆轨迹树的 memory-control policy。Agent 通过显式 `<reflect>` 将已验证事实、缺失证据与分支风险压缩进工作记忆，并用 `<backtrack>` 从活动上下文移除不可靠后缀、恢复已验证状态，同时保留纠错教训；训练以 answer-masked 特权教师提供局部密集蒸馏信号，再用 outcome-based GRPO 对完整轨迹做全局校准。模型在 HotpotQA 与 2Wiki 上训练，在 Bamboogle、FRAMES、MuSiQue、NQ、TriviaQA 等七个检索 QA 基准评测；Qwen2.5-3B/7B 的平均 F1 为 46.15/49.21，分别比最强 AgenticRAG-R1 基线高 12.60/12.61 个点，去掉 reflect 或 backtrack 会使 3B 平均 F1 下降 15.31 或 13.06 点。
details.abstractEn: LoongReflect formulates long-horizon reflection as a memory-control policy over a reversible trajectory tree. Explicit `<reflect>` actions consolidate verified facts, missing evidence, and branch risks into working memory, while `<backtrack>` removes an unreliable suffix from active context, restores a validated state, and preserves a corrective lesson; answer-masked privileged-teacher distillation supplies dense local supervision and outcome-based GRPO calibrates complete trajectories globally. Trained on HotpotQA and 2Wiki and evaluated across seven retrieval-QA benchmarks including Bamboogle, FRAMES, MuSiQue, NQ, and TriviaQA, Qwen2.5-3B/7B reach average F1 scores of 46.15/49.21—12.60/12.61 points above the strongest AgenticRAG-R1 baseline; removing reflect or backtrack lowers the 3B average by 15.31 or 13.06 points.

entries.title: Marco DeepResearch: Unlocking Efficient Deep Research Agents via Verification-Centric Design
entries.description: A main agent, search sub-agent, and independent verifier construct corrected tool-use trajectories, while inference resets degraded contexts and verifies candidate answers under a fixed search budget.

details.abstractZh: Marco DeepResearch 把验证贯穿数据、训练与推理：Main Agent 分解问题，Search Sub-Agent 调用 web 工具，独立 Verifier 对子任务和最终答案验收；失败会触发 revision、重执行和 verification-reflection re-rollout。Qwen3-8B 在超过 1.2 万条合成 QA 与验证轨迹上 SFT，并用 2000 余条留出数据做 outcome-reward GRPO；推理时 Discard All 清空退化上下文，独立检查多个候选，再由 Joint Verify 在固定工具预算内给出答案。六个 deep-search 基准中，Discard All+Verify 相对基础 SFT+RL 在 GAIA/xBench-2505/BrowseComp-200/BrowseComp-ZH 上从 61.2/75.0/17.3/29.3 提升到 69.9/82.0/32.3/47.1，但当前仍是 arXiv 预印本。
details.abstractEn: Marco DeepResearch makes verification central to data, training, and inference: a Main Agent decomposes questions, a Search Sub-Agent uses web tools, and an independent Verifier checks subtasks and final answers, with failures triggering revision, re-execution, and verification-reflection re-rollouts. Qwen3-8B receives SFT on more than 12,000 synthesized QA examples and verified trajectories followed by outcome-reward GRPO on over 2,000 held-out examples; at inference, Discard All resets degraded contexts, candidate answers are independently checked, and Joint Verify selects the final answer under a fixed tool budget. Across six deep-search benchmarks, Discard All+Verify improves GAIA/xBench-2505/BrowseComp-200/BrowseComp-ZH from 61.2/75.0/17.3/29.3 for base SFT+RL to 69.9/82.0/32.3/47.1, although the work remains an arXiv preprint.

entries.title: LegalMALR: Multi-Agent Query Understanding and LLM-Based Reranking for Chinese Statute Retrieval
entries.description: Multi-agent system reformulates implicit legal queries from multiple perspectives with iterative dense retrieval; GRPO-optimized MAS policy reduces randomness; LLM Reranker applies natural-language legal reasoning for statute applicability judgment.

details.abstractZh: LegalMALR 在一个系统中同时实现多 Agent query understanding 与 LLM reasoning reranker。前级 MAS 从不同法律视角对隐含、多问题、口语化 query 进行 reformulation，并迭代调用 dense retriever 扩充候选；统一 MAS policy 通过 GRPO 优化以降低多 Agent rewrite 的随机性，最后交给 LLM Reranker 用自然语言法律推理判断法条适用性。作者还构建了含 118 个困难中文法律查询的 CSAID，并与公开 STARD 一起评测；LegalMALR 在 ID 与 OOD 设置均显著超过强 RAG 基线。虽然场景是法条检索，但架构非常接近工业搜索未来的 'query-agent → retrieval → reasoning rerank' pipeline。
details.abstractEn: LegalMALR implements multi-agent query understanding and LLM reasoning reranking in a single system. A front-end MAS reformulates implicit, multi-issue, colloquial queries from different legal perspectives and iteratively expands candidates with a dense retriever; a unified MAS policy optimized via GRPO reduces randomness in multi-agent rewriting; a final LLM Reranker applies natural-language legal reasoning for statute applicability judgment. The authors also build CSAID with 118 hard Chinese legal queries, evaluating alongside STARD; LegalMALR significantly outperforms strong RAG baselines on both ID and OOD settings. Though focused on statute retrieval, the architecture closely mirrors a future industrial 'query-agent → retrieval → reasoning rerank' pipeline.

entries.title: Agentic-R: Learning to Retrieve for Agentic Search
institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China
entries.description: Alternates PPO training of a multi-turn search agent with contrastive retriever updates from its trajectories, optimizing passage utility for both local query relevance and final-answer correctness.

details.abstractZh: Agentic-R 不把 retriever 当作固定工具，而是在两轮双向优化中交替训练搜索 Agent 与检索器：Qwen2.5-7B Agent 以 PPO 学习最多五轮 reasoning→query→retrieval，检索器再从新轨迹中以局部 query relevance 与全局最终答案正确性联合定义 passage utility 做对比学习。实验覆盖 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle、NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA，并用 2018-12 Wikipedia 对 E5 初始化的检索器训练。域内 Agent 的平均 EM 为 45.00，高于最强列出基线 REPLUG 的 41.78；去掉全局正确性或局部相关性平均 EM 约下降 1.1/1.7 点，相比 REPLUG 在 HotpotQA/TriviaQA 的平均搜索轮数约减少 10%/15%。
details.abstractEn: Agentic-R does not treat the retriever as a fixed tool. In two rounds of bidirectional optimization, a Qwen2.5-7B search agent learns up to five reasoning→query→retrieval turns with PPO, while the retriever is contrastively updated from the agent's new trajectories using passage utility that combines local query relevance with global final-answer correctness. Evaluation spans HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, Bamboogle, NQ, TriviaQA, and PopQA, training an E5-initialized retriever over a December 2018 Wikipedia corpus. With the in-domain agent, average EM is 45.00 versus 41.78 for the strongest listed baseline REPLUG; removing global correctness or local relevance lowers average EM by about 1.1/1.7 points, and average search turns fall by roughly 10%/15% on HotpotQA/TriviaQA versus REPLUG.

entries.title: QAgent: A Modular Search Agent with Interactive Query Understanding
entries.description: Transforms query understanding from one-shot rewrite into interactive reasoning↔retrieval multi-step decision; modular pluggable design allows the RL-trained query-understanding agent to be inserted into existing search pipelines without full replacement.

details.abstractZh: QAgent 把 query understanding 从一次性 query rewrite 变为一个 interactive reasoning ↔ retrieval 的多步决策过程。它是模块化 agentic RAG：Agent 根据上一轮检索反馈决定下一步如何理解/重写查询，通过 RL 最大化检索质量，并特意设计成可插拔模块，使训练好的 query-understanding agent 能接入已有搜索/RAG 系统而不必整体替换线上 pipeline。论文报告其在 QA 和检索场景均优于比较系统，并强调相较 end-to-end agent，以检索为中心的 RL 在泛化与部署上更稳定。
details.abstractEn: QAgent transforms query understanding from one-shot query rewrite into an interactive reasoning↔retrieval multi-step decision process. As a modular agentic RAG, the agent decides how to understand/rewrite the query based on the previous retrieval feedback; RL maximizes retrieval quality. The pluggable design allows the trained query-understanding agent to be inserted into existing search/RAG systems without full pipeline replacement. The paper reports improvements over comparison systems on both QA and retrieval scenarios, emphasizing that retrieval-focused RL is more stable in generalization and deployment than end-to-end agents.

entries.title: REARANK: Reasoning Re-ranking Agent via Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Upgrades LLM reranker to a 'reason first, then listwise rank' agent; RL trains reasoning/ranking policy from only 179 annotated samples; REARANK-7B surpasses GPT-4 on the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark.

details.abstractZh: REARANK 将 LLM reranker 明确升级成一个“” reasoning、再 listwise ranking“” reranking agent，并用 RL 训练 reasoning/ranking policy。结合数据增强，仅依赖 179 个标注样本训练 Qwen2.5-7B 版本；其目标不是让大模型直接逐文档打分，而是在排序前形成可解释的判断轨迹。实验覆盖多个 in-domain / out-of-domain IR benchmark；REARANK-7B 总体达到接近 GPT-4 的 reranking 表现，并在推理密集的 BRIGHT benchmark 上超过 GPT-4。这是 2025 年“”gent × reranking“”最直接、最干净的一项工作。
details.abstractEn: REARANK explicitly upgrades the LLM reranker into a 'reason first, then listwise rank' reranking agent, using RL to train the reasoning/ranking policy. With data augmentation, it trains a Qwen2.5-7B version from only 179 annotated samples; the goal is to form an interpretable judgment trajectory before sorting rather than having the model score documents one by one. Experiments cover multiple in-domain/out-of-domain IR benchmarks; REARANK-7B overall reaches near-GPT-4 reranking performance and surpasses GPT-4 on the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark. This is the most direct and clean 'Agent × reranking' work of 2025.

entries.title: DMRL: Document-Mediated Reinforcement Learning for Skill Optimization in Advertising Recommendation
entries.description: A bilevel closed loop trains an upper agent to edit advertising-control skill documents while a frozen lower agent executes bounded parameter interventions and online A/B outcomes drive delayed-reward policy updates.

details.abstractZh: DMRL 将广告推荐参数优化建模为双层 Agent 闭环：上层 Qwen3 优化器把 skill document 的修改拆成结构化原子编辑，下层冻结的任务 Agent 只在参数白名单和值域内调用工具执行干预，再由在线 A/B 结果反哺下一轮编辑。DRPO 同时比较 rollout 组内的稳健 MAD advantage 与 treatment-control reward，并惩罚编辑幅度；LRP 用约 1200 万条按时间切分的用户轨迹、群体解耦表示和历史 memory bank，从 1 日信号预测 7 日长期结果。一个未具名的大规模短视频广告平台实验中，完整 DMRL 的 AUD@1d/PES@1d/AUD@7d/PES@7d/LTV 变化为 -0.020%/+0.644%/+0.082%/+0.960%/+0.052%，LTV 高于最佳对比 SkillOpt 的 +0.024%；作者机构含快手科技，但原文未指明部署平台，且该收益伴随短期 AUD 轻微下降。
details.abstractEn: DMRL formulates advertising-recommendation parameter optimization as a bilevel agent loop: an upper-level Qwen3 optimizer turns skill-document revisions into structured atomic edits, while a frozen task agent invokes tools only within a whitelist of parameters and value ranges, and online A/B outcomes feed the next edit cycle. DRPO combines robust MAD-normalized within-group advantage, treatment-control reward, and an edit-cost penalty; LRP uses roughly 12 million chronologically split user trajectories, disentangled population representations, and a historical memory bank to predict seven-day outcomes from one-day signals. On an unnamed large-scale short-video advertising platform, full DMRL reports AUD@1d/PES@1d/AUD@7d/PES@7d/LTV changes of −0.020%/+0.644%/+0.082%/+0.960%/+0.052%, versus +0.024% LTV for the strongest SkillOpt comparison; authors are affiliated with Kuaishou Technology, but the paper does not identify the deployed platform, and short-term AUD declines slightly.

entries.title: LangBP: Language-Guided Reasoning and Acting for Joint Bidding and Pricing
entries.description: A high-level language policy plans campaign strategy while a Semantic Decision Transformer executes joint bidding/pricing actions, with effect verification and execution-grouped policy optimization closing the control loop.

details.abstractZh: LangBP 把联合出价与定价拆成语言引导的层级控制：高层 instruction policy 生成解释、bidding direction 和 pricing strength，低层 Semantic Decision Transformer 根据指令与轨迹历史预测目标状态变化，再由 inverse dynamics 还原连续动作。Context–Effect Verifier 从历史行为支持度校验策略效果，Execution-Grouped Policy Optimization 按语义相近的 effect 分组分配 credit；离线在 AuctionNet/AuctionNet-Sparse 的 48 个广告主、五档预算、五次运行上评测，dense 设置相对 JD-BP 提升约 4.2%–6.5%。一个未具名大型电商广告平台的七天线上 A/B 报告 Ad Click +2.59%、Ad Cost +1.86%、Ad Value +3.34%、Achievement +1.83 个百分点；作者机构含 JD.com，但原文未据此声称部署平台就是京东。
details.abstractEn: LangBP decomposes joint bidding and pricing into language-guided hierarchical control: a high-level instruction policy emits an explanation, bidding direction, and pricing strength; a low-level Semantic Decision Transformer predicts target state changes from that instruction and trajectory history, and inverse dynamics recovers continuous actions. A Context–Effect Verifier checks whether effects are supported by behavior, while Execution-Grouped Policy Optimization assigns credit among semantically similar effects; offline evaluation spans 48 advertisers, five budget ratios, and five runs on AuctionNet/AuctionNet-Sparse, with roughly 4.2%–6.5% gains over JD-BP in the dense setting. A seven-day online A/B test on an unnamed large-scale e-commerce advertising platform reports +2.59% Ad Click, +1.86% Ad Cost, +3.34% Ad Value, and +1.83 percentage points Achievement; JD.com is an author affiliation, but the paper does not identify the deployed platform as JD.

entries.title: Fine-Tuning Autobidders with Group Relative Policy Optimization
entries.description: AB-GRPO samples groups of complete bidding trajectories under a shared campaign context and learns a critic-free bounded correction to an adaptive linear pacing controller from relative trajectory rewards.

details.abstractZh: AB-GRPO 将用于大模型后训练的 group-relative policy optimization 迁移到带预算与目标 CPC 约束的 campaign 级竞价 MDP。系统在相同 campaign context 下采样多条完整 bid trajectory，以组内相对 reward 训练单一 policy，不学习 critic；policy 只输出对已调优 Adaptive Linear Model 增益的有界修正，因此是在受约束控制器之上的 trajectory-level RL，而非 LLM Agent。论文在 BAT、iPinYou、AuctionNet 三个公开离线环境中比较启发式、PID/M-PID 与 actor–critic RL：BAT 上 clicks/conversions 为 7,764/766（ALM 为 7,669/757），iPinYou clicks 为 937.8±11.8，AuctionNet clicks/conversions 为 19,677.79/869.08。作者明确未报告生产部署或线上 A/B，且在 AuctionNet clicks 上 PID 的 19,784.77 略高，因此应将其视为广告投放控制中的轨迹优化证据而非已验证工业收益。
details.abstractEn: AB-GRPO transfers group-relative policy optimization from LLM post-training to a campaign-level bidding MDP with budget and target-CPC constraints. It samples groups of complete bid trajectories under the same campaign context and trains one policy from relative rewards without a critic; the policy emits only a bounded correction to a tuned Adaptive Linear Model gain, making this trajectory-level RL over a constrained controller rather than an LLM agent. Against heuristic, PID/M-PID, and actor–critic RL baselines on the public BAT, iPinYou, and AuctionNet offline environments, it reports 7,764 clicks and 766 conversions on BAT versus 7,669/757 for ALM, 937.8±11.8 clicks on iPinYou, and 19,677.79 clicks with 869.08 conversions on AuctionNet. No production deployment or online A/B test is reported, and PID's 19,784.77 AuctionNet clicks are slightly higher, so the result is evidence for trajectory optimization in ad control rather than validated business lift.

entries.title: Astar: Learning to Propose Evolution Directions for Self-Evolving Industrial AI Systems
entries.description: Astar learns evolution directions from implementation–training–evaluation histories, scores proposals with a learned surrogate, and closes the loop through automatic implementation, training, evaluation, and incremental feedback.

details.abstractZh: Astar 不是直接竞价或排序的 serving Agent，而是学习如何为工业广告召回系统提出下一步演化方向。它从真实 implementation→training→evaluation 提交历史构建样本，用三层 hierarchical hints 缩小改动空间，经 mid-training、SFT 与 RL 训练方向生成模型，并用持续更新的 reward-model surrogate 筛选候选；通过自动实现、训练、评测与结果回灌形成闭环。Astar-8B 的真实执行单提议成功率 S@1 为 0.6786，高于资深工程师的 0.3229 和论文所列最强通用模型的 0.3071；在 Alibaba Lazada 广告 recall model 上连续两周完成 20 次迭代，离线 Hitrate@200 +23.6%。2026-07-01 至 07-05 的随机流量线上 A/B 报告 GMV +4.86%、广告收入 +1.82%、clicks +0.84%、orders +1.79%，均为论文作者报告。
details.abstractEn: Astar is not a serving-time bidder or ranker; it learns how to propose the next evolution direction for an industrial advertising retrieval system. It constructs training examples from implementation→training→evaluation histories, narrows the change space with three-level hierarchical hints, trains the direction model with mid-training, SFT, and RL, and filters proposals with an incrementally updated reward-model surrogate; automatic implementation, training, evaluation, and feedback close the loop. Astar-8B reports real-execution single-proposal success S@1 of 0.6786 versus 0.3229 for senior engineers and 0.3071 for the strongest named general-purpose model; on Alibaba Lazada's advertising recall model, 20 consecutive iterations over two weeks improve offline Hitrate@200 by 23.6%. A randomized online A/B test from July 1–5, 2026 reports GMV +4.86%, advertising revenue +1.82%, clicks +0.84%, and orders +1.79%; all figures are author-reported.

entries.title: AdsWorldEngine: A Self-Evolving Conversational Advertising Agent through Orchestrator and Tool Coevolution
entries.description: A gated advertising agent resolves dialogue state, generates commercial intents, calls retrieval/relevance/ranking tools, reflects over candidates, and alternates trajectory-level Orchestrator RL with preference updates to the tools themselves.

details.abstractZh: AdsWorldEngine 将对话广告建模为端到端 Agent 决策：Opportunity Gate 判断当前轮是否适合展示广告，Orchestrator 解析多轮状态、生成 1–3 个商业意图并调用检索/相关性/排序工具，再由 reflection 从候选中选出 top-3，离线 Evaluator 为完整轨迹提供相关性与多样性奖励。系统先用 SFT+GRPO 训练 Orchestrator，再把高低奖励 rollout 转成 preference triples 训练 intent-to-ads 工具，交替三轮形成 actor–tool 共进化；主观判断模型还用人类标签生成思维轨迹、反思过滤和 cost-sensitive GRPO 保留非对称错误代价。相对当前生产系统，三轮后离线 diversity +62.87%、relevance +82.26%；部署到全球 Microsoft Copilot surfaces 的 20 天在线 A/B 中，RPM +22%、广告覆盖率 +74%。
details.abstractEn: AdsWorldEngine formulates conversational advertising as an end-to-end agent decision: an Opportunity Gate decides whether a turn is suitable for ads, an Orchestrator resolves multi-turn state, generates one to three commercial intents, calls retrieval/relevance/ranking tools, and reflects over candidates to select a top-three slate, while an offline Evaluator supplies relevance and diversity rewards for complete trajectories. The system first trains the Orchestrator with SFT and GRPO, then converts high/low-reward rollouts into preference triples for the intent-to-ads tool, alternating for three actor–tool coevolution rounds; judgment models use human-label-conditioned reasoning traces, reflection filtering, and cost-sensitive GRPO to preserve asymmetric error costs. After three rounds, offline diversity and relevance improve 62.87% and 82.26% over the production system; a 20-day online A/B deployment across Microsoft Copilot surfaces worldwide reports RPM +22% and ad coverage +74%.

entries.title: Beyond Single-Episode Optimization: Sliding-Window Aware Generative Auto-Bidding for Long-Term Advertising Effectiveness
entries.description: SWAG-Bid couples an episode-level masked-trajectory planner with a step-level gated Decision Transformer to optimize every overlapping seven-day efficiency window rather than treating each day independently.

details.abstractZh: SWAG-Bid 将广告自动竞价从单日 episode 扩展到七日滑动窗口约束下的跨 episode 长程规划。上层 Masked Trajectory Model 预测未来市场并生成候选计划，Multi-Window MPC Sampling 同时评估所有重叠窗口；下层 Decision Transformer 通过 PSG-AdaLN 状态门控以及 RTG/CTG 双通道执行逐步竞价。除 AuctionNet-Sparse 离线实验外，AliExpress 进行了连续 21 天、10% 流量的 campaign 级 A/B：平均 cost +1.96%、GMV +3.42%、ROAS +5.65%，窗口约束达成率 +2.02 个百分点。
details.abstractEn: SWAG-Bid extends auto-bidding from independent daily episodes to long-horizon planning under overlapping seven-day efficiency windows. An upper Masked Trajectory Model forecasts markets and generates candidate plans scored jointly by Multi-Window MPC Sampling; a lower Decision Transformer executes bids through PSG-AdaLN state-adaptive gating and RTG/CTG channels. Besides AuctionNet-Sparse experiments, a 21-day AliExpress campaign-level A/B test on 10% traffic reports cost +1.96%, GMV +3.42%, ROAS +5.65%, and constraint achievement +2.02 percentage points.

entries.title: AIGB-R1: Self-Evolving Generative Auto-Bidding via Hierarchical Planner-Executor Optimization
institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China
entries.description: A 32B Planner writes period-level strategies into task memory while a lightweight Prompt Decision Transformer executes bids; decoupled GRPO optimizes both roles from interactive auction trajectories.

details.abstractZh: AIGB-R1 用 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct Planner 每个投放周期读取广告主上下文和历史表现，生成结构化宏观策略；六层 Prompt Decision Transformer Executor 再结合 RTG/state/action 轨迹输出细粒度 bidding parameters。AuctionNetEnv 提供交互式二价拍卖 rollout，每个任务的 memory 同时保留 best-strategy anchor 与 FIFO window，Decoupled GRPO 则分别计算 Planner 和 Executor advantage 并端到端优化两者。AuctionNet/AuctionNet-Sparse 上的 Score 为 385±3.61/39.0±0.37，高于下一名 376/38.1；静态 Planner 或不训练 Executor 时 dense Score 降至 371/343，但全部证据来自公开数据与模拟器，论文不声称生产 A/B。
details.abstractEn: AIGB-R1 uses a Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct Planner to read advertiser context and historical performance once per delivery period and emit a structured macro strategy; a six-layer Prompt Decision Transformer Executor combines that prompt with return-to-go/state/action history to produce fine-grained bidding parameters. AuctionNetEnv supplies interactive second-price-auction rollouts, task memory retains both a best-strategy anchor and FIFO window, and Decoupled GRPO computes separate Planner and Executor advantages while optimizing both end to end. Scores on AuctionNet/AuctionNet-Sparse are 385±3.61 and 39.0±0.37 versus 376 and 38.1 for the next-best methods; dense Score drops to 371 with a static Planner and 343 without Executor RL, but all evidence comes from public data and simulation rather than production A/B tests.

entries.title: HOBA: Hierarchical On-Policy Bidding Agents for Adaptive Online Advertising
entries.description: Three-time-scale bidding control combines an LLM Think–Act–Observe–Reflect strategist with memory retrieval, a causal-adjusted SARSA expert selector, and a dynamic PID/MPC/IQL/Decision-Transformer expert pool.

details.abstractZh: HOBA 是 Kuaishou 的三时间尺度分层竞价 Agent：高层 LLM 通过 Think–Act–Observe–Reflect 与历史经验检索推断超参数，中层 SARSA Agent 在带因果校正的反馈下选择专家，底层 PID、MPC、IQL、Decision Transformer 专家池执行实时竞价。AuctionNet 消融显示去掉 SARSA、LLM、记忆检索分别使分数下降 10.7%、7.1%、3.6%，在线 P99 延迟为 38 ms。4,982 个 campaign 的大规模 A/B 中，目标成本达成率由 90.0% 升至 93.2%，conversion value +8.1%、ROI +3.3%、预算完成率 +3.8%、广告主满意度 +7.6%。
details.abstractEn: HOBA is Kuaishou's three-time-scale hierarchical bidding agent: a high-level LLM uses Think–Act–Observe–Reflect with experience retrieval to infer hyperparameters, a causal-adjusted SARSA agent selects experts, and a PID/MPC/IQL/Decision-Transformer pool executes real-time bids. AuctionNet ablations show score drops of 10.7%, 7.1%, and 3.6% without SARSA, the LLM, and memory retrieval, respectively; online P99 latency is 38 ms. In a large A/B test over 4,982 campaigns, target-cost achievement rises from 90.0% to 93.2%, with conversion value +8.1%, ROI +3.3%, budget completion +3.8%, and advertiser satisfaction +7.6%.

entries.title: KP-Agent: Keyword Pruning in Sponsored Search Advertising via LLM-Powered Contextual Bandits
entries.description: Models sponsored-search keyword pruning as an LLM-powered contextual bandit agent operating at the campaign/keyword control layer, learning policy via reinforcement signal to progressively refine keyword sets without entering millisecond-level serving.

details.abstractZh: KP-Agent 把 sponsored search 中的 keyword pruning 建模为 LLM-powered contextual bandit Agent：Agent 在 advertiser context 下决定如何调整关键词集合，并通过 reinforcement signal 逐步改进策略，而不是只依赖静态 supervised pruning classifier。ACM 摘要描述其会生成代码/动作来细化 keyword set，并用 contextual-bandit formulation 处理决策。它的价值在于：广告 Agent 不一定直接生成广告，而可以位于 campaign/keyword control layer，根据收益反馈自动执行运营决策，从而避开毫秒级 serving hot path。
details.abstractEn: KP-Agent models sponsored-search keyword pruning as an LLM-powered contextual bandit agent: the agent decides how to adjust keyword sets under advertiser context and improves strategy progressively via reinforcement signal rather than relying solely on a static supervised pruning classifier. The ACM abstract describes it generating code/actions to refine keyword sets using a contextual-bandit formulation. Its value is that an ad agent need not directly generate ads but can operate at the campaign/keyword control layer, automatically executing operational decisions based on reward feedback, avoiding the millisecond-level serving hot path.

entries.title: AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems
entries.description: NetEase's multi-expert harness coordinates proposals, adversarial review, code, training, evaluation, and persistent experiment-state updates, stopping at a human-gated Launch Review for online testing.

details.abstractZh: AutoLR 在网易 DASHEN 游戏社区推荐系统中把研究假设、multi-expert council 审查、代码实现、训练、离线评测和 experiment-state 回写串成闭环，并以确定性的 evidence-weighted exploration/exploitation selector、执行器、指标和 guardrail 约束 LLM；自主流程止于离线候选打包，由工程师决定线上 A/B，Launch Review 保留人工门禁。数月审计覆盖两个推荐场景、1,586 次唯一完成评测和 9 次正向生产 Launch Review；异构 signed lift 记录的描述性总和为消费渗透 +5.75%、总消费时长 +10.83%、有效播放 +5.55%，单次迭代 LLM API 成本约人民币 3–4 元（不含训练与基础设施）。证据只来自一个应用和两个场景，指标不是 pooled treatment effect，论文也缺少组件级因果效应、false-promotion rate、完整随机化/置信区间及不可变的离线到线上 lineage。
details.abstractEn: AutoLR connects research hypotheses, multi-expert adversarial review, code implementation, training, offline evaluation, and experiment-state write-back for NetEase's DASHEN recommender. Deterministic evidence-weighted exploration/exploitation selection, execution, metrics, and guardrails bound the LLM, and autonomy stops at offline candidate packaging before engineers choose online A/B tests through a human-gated Launch Review. The audited corpus spans two scenarios, 1,586 unique completed evaluations, and nine positive production Launch Reviews; heterogeneous signed lift records sum descriptively to +5.75% consumption penetration, +10.83% total consumption time, and +5.55% valid views, with RMB 3–4 LLM API cost per iteration excluding training and infrastructure. Evidence covers one application and two scenarios, the lift sums are not pooled treatment effects, and component-level causality, false-promotion rate, complete randomization/confidence records, and immutable offline-to-online lineage are unavailable.

entries.title: Inventory-Grounded Policy-Level Optimization for Training-Free AI Search
entries.description: Huawei's commercial AI-search loop probes runtime inventory, diagnoses policy versus inventory failures through grouped rollouts, replay-validates guideline edits, and persists stage-specific policies without model training.

details.abstractZh: IGPO 面向固定模型的商业 AI search pipeline：运行时探测可用 inventory 并构造 inventory portrait，离线 stochastic grouped rollouts 区分 route policy 缺失与底层 inventory 缺失，inventory-guided exploration 生成 stage-specific guideline，经过 replay validation 后写入持久 policy store，再注入线上 retrieval/selection。系统自 2026 年 5 月部署；14 天 50/50 随机 A/B 覆盖 100,400 个 control 和 99,800 个 treatment 用户，CTR 相对提升 3.17%（95% CI 1.9–4.5%，p<0.001），审计 bad cases 降低 38.9%（95% CI 25.2–50.1%），延迟开销为 p50 49.4ms、p95 185.8ms。效果依赖 inventory probe、metadata 和检索接口的完整性，维护证据仅覆盖 31 天和 43–64 条 guideline 的规模，长期增长、跨系统迁移及主动 stale-guideline 检测尚未验证。
details.abstractEn: IGPO adapts a fixed commercial AI-search pipeline by probing runtime inventory and constructing inventory portraits. Offline stochastic grouped rollouts distinguish missing route policy from missing underlying inventory; inventory-guided exploration proposes stage-specific guidelines, replay validation filters edits, and a persistent policy store injects them into online retrieval and selection without model training.
